title: Instant Portal Nether
description: Makes Nether portals teleport players instantly, just like End portals.
body:
Tired of waiting 4 seconds every time you step into a Nether portal?

Instant Portal Nether makes Nether portals work just like End portals — the moment you step in, you're teleported immediately. No delays, no waiting, just instant travel.

## Features
- Instant teleportation on contact with Nether portals
- Works exactly like End portals
- Toggle ON/OFF via Mod Menu config screen
- Keybinding to toggle instantly in-game (default: K)
- Config is saved persistently between sessions
- Lightweight — no bloat, zero performance impact
- Compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer servers

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.2 or later
- Fabric Loader >= 0.19.3
- Fabric API

## Optional
- Mod Menu (for in-game config screen)
